name: Incredible Endurance
body:
You do not fatigue easily.

Prerequisites: Con 15, half-dwarf.

Benefit: When an effect would cause you to become fatigued, you ignore that effect. You can benefit from this a number of times each day equal to half your Constitution bonus.

Special: This feat meets the Endurance prerequisite of other feats, class features, or options.
